head: iPhone Duo Display Zoom missing after setup: you can't change it later
dek: On the iPhone Duo you choose Display Zoom (default, medium or large) only during setup; Settings has no option to change it afterwards, unlike other iPhones. MacRumors confirmed it on iOS 27.2.
details: Display Zoom makes icons and the whole screen bigger. Text size still works in Appearance and Accessibility settings. Apple hasn't commented.
means: If you're setting up an iPhone Duo, the screen size you choose sticks.
todo: Pick your Display Zoom carefully during setup; to change it later you have to back up and reset the phone, or use larger text instead.
